seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Mesquite, NV 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Mesquite, NV: the Parade of Lights, Mesquite Toes Christmas Spectacular, Santa photos, library crafts and Christmas at the Farm.
lede: Mesquite celebrates Christmas with a city Parade of Lights, a community theatre full of holiday shows and library crafts, plus a Moapa Valley farm that turns on its Christmas lights.
celebrates: The City of Mesquite leads the season with its Parade of Lights down Mesquite Boulevard, themed Home for the Holidays this year, with free cocoa and cookies and Santa before the parade. Mesquite Community Theatre fills the calendar with a Hollywood Christmas variety show, the Mesquite Toes Christmas Spectacular, Karaoke Christmas with free photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus, and a Christmas show by the Edwards Twins. The Mesquite Library offers a Winter Craft Buffet, Gingerbread Storytime and a Grinch movie with cocoa. Just up the valley, Moapa Valley Corn Maze opens for Christmas at the Farm.
lastyear: On Thursday, December 4, 2025, thirty-nine entries paraded down Mesquite Boulevard in the Parade of Lights, according to the Mesquite Local News. Spectators were asked to bring nonperishable foods for a local food drive. The City's recreation department shared video of the 2025 parade on its Facebook page, and the 2026 post promises another evening of cocoa, cookies, Santa and holiday music before the lights roll by.
facts: The Mesquite-Toes Dance Troupe was founded in 2003 and is a nonprofit adult dance group of energetic men and women. The community calls them its official Goodwill Ambassadors of the Magic of Mesquite. Their Christmas Spectacular always ends with the March of the Wooden Soldiers. Mesquite Community Theatre's Lights On Christmas Variety Show is in its third year in 2026, and Moapa Valley Corn Maze is opening for Christmas for the first time this year.
trains: For a family train ride, the closest option is the Nevada State Railroad Museum in Boulder City, which runs 45-minute rides on the old Boulder City Branch Line, with Santa Trains in the Christmas season. The Mesquite Library's Cocoa and a Movie program also shows the 1966 Dr. Seuss classic, How the Grinch Stole Christmas, on December 22 if you want a Christmas story closer to home.

faq: When is the Mesquite Parade of Lights in 2026?

The City of Mesquite holds the Parade of Lights on Thursday, December 3, 2026, from 5:30 to 7 pm down Mesquite Boulevard between Arrowhead and Willow. It is free to watch. The city's recreation department says free cocoa and cookies start at 5 pm while supplies last, with Santa visiting the kids.
Where can kids meet Santa in Mesquite?

Santa visits before the Parade of Lights and joins Mrs. Claus for free photos at Karaoke Christmas at Mesquite Community Theatre on December 12. Moapa Valley Corn Maze also includes a Santa visit with admission, and it asks guests to reserve a time slot. Each event listing on this page has the details.
What Christmas shows are at Mesquite Community Theatre?

The theatre lists Lights On A Hollywood Christmas Variety Show on November 27 and 28, the Mesquite Toes Christmas Spectacular on December 4 and 5, Karaoke Christmas on December 12 and a Christmas show by the Edwards Twins on December 21 at 1 pm.
Are there free Christmas events in Mesquite?

The Parade of Lights is free, and Karaoke Christmas offers free photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus with complimentary hot cocoa. Mesquite Library programs and some theatre shows do not print a price, so check with the host. Moapa Valley Corn Maze charges $12 general admission.
Is there a train ride near Mesquite?

The Nevada State Railroad Museum in Boulder City runs Santa Trains on the old Boulder City Branch Line, with 45-minute rides. See the Las Vegas guide for the current Boulder City listing, dates and ticket details, since schedules and prices change by date.

Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Mesquite for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Lights On: A Hollywood Christmas Variety Show) through December 22 (Cocoa and a Movie at Mesquite Library), with the Parade of Lights (December 3), the Mesquite Toes Christmas Spectacular (December 4 and 5) and Christmas at the Farm at Moapa Valley Corn Maze (December 4 to 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
